caption: Table-level lineage: every upstream and downstream table, automatic.
Only the exact upstream columns that fed this one light up.

eyebrow: Lineage as a compliance query, not a glance
code:
SELECT source_table_full_name, source_column_name,
       target_table_full_name, target_column_name
FROM system.access.column_lineage
WHERE source_column_name = 'ssn'
  AND source_table_full_name = 'nyc_taxi.silver.customers';
caption: A repeatable audit query, not a UI click-through exercise.
